text:
It is 11 p.m. You have not lifted in 5 days. Stop lying to yourself.

This is the midnight excuse. Phone in hand. Stress you have not dealt with. Body getting softer every day.

Your body runs on what you do. Not what you plan. Not what you mean to do. What you actually do.

4 days lifting. 8 hours sleep. Clean food. Kill the excuse.

Boys wait to feel better. Men fix the base and better follows.
caption:
Most men search for mindset tips while their body chemistry pulls them back. Self improvement starts in the body.
Send this to a man who needs it today.
